player.hud.play_pause.description: Label for a declared player HUD pill or button that toggles playback; stable wording so its measured width does not change when paused.

player.hud.skip_back.description: Label for a declared player HUD pill or button that seeks backward; the command owns the interval.

player.hud.skip_forward.description: Label for a declared player HUD pill or button that seeks forward; the command owns the interval.
